title: Cache Locality
objective: Measure how the order of memory accesses changes the hit rate of a small data cache, then reorder a loop so that it uses the data the cache fetches.
explanation:
A cache keeps copies of recently used memory in lines of several consecutive bytes. On a miss it fetches a whole line, so the neighbouring words are already there for the next accesses (spatial locality). Which set a line goes to is decided by address bits: in a direct-mapped cache, two lines with the same set bits evict each other (conflict misses).

This mission's data cache: 256 bytes, direct-mapped, 16 lines of 16 bytes (4 words). The address bits are: bits 1–0 byte, bits 3–2 word in the line, bits 7–4 set, the rest tag.

The matrix is stored row by row: m[r][c] is at matrix + (16r + c) · 4. Walking down a column jumps 64 bytes per step, so every access lands in a different line, and only 4 of the 16 sets are used for the 16 rows of a column.

Fidelity. The hit and miss counts come from the data accesses recorded in the trace, run through the same cache rules as Ripes' cache simulator; you can watch the same cache in the Cache tab (data cache: 2N Ways = 0, 2N Sets = 4, 2N Words per Line = 2, LRU, write-back, write-allocate). Ripes' processors use ideal memory, so in Ripes a miss costs no cycles. On a timing model it does: the same kind of experiment on gem5's out-of-order CPU (4 KiB L1 data cache, 2048 loads, tools/gem5/README.md) took 6,939 cycles with 2,030 L1 misses for strided accesses and 2,601 cycles with 119 misses for sequential accesses.

steps.title: Load the program
steps.instruction: Click Load example and Select processor. The program sums a 16 × 16 matrix column by column.

steps.title: Run it and check the sum
steps.instruction: Run to the end. The sum of 1 … 256 is a0 = 32896. In the Explorer, look at the lw instructions: their addresses grow by 64 bytes from one row to the next.

steps.title: Measure the data cache
steps.instruction: Each of the 256 loads misses: a column touches 16 different lines that compete for 4 sets, and by the time the next column needs a line again, it has been evicted. Compare with the Cache tab configured as described above.

challenge.text: Compute the same sum (a0 = 32896) with all 256 loads, reaching a data cache hit rate of at least 70 % on this mission's cache.
challenge.hint: Visit the matrix in the order it is stored in memory: swap the two loops so that consecutive loads are 4 bytes apart.

completion: Row by row, each miss brings in a line of four words and the next three loads hit: 64 misses and 192 hits (75 %). Column by column, every load missed. Same instructions, same result, very different memory behaviour; on a processor with a real memory system that difference becomes time.

zh_CN.title: 缓存局部性
zh_CN.objective: 测量内存访问的顺序如何改变一个小型数据缓存的命中率，然后重排循环，让它用上缓存取来的数据。
zh_CN.explanation:
缓存以缓存行（若干个连续字节）为单位保存最近用过的内存的副本。发生缺失时，它会取回整个缓存行，因此相邻的字在接下来的访问中已经就绪（空间局部性）。缓存行放入哪个组由地址位决定：在直接映射缓存中，组号位相同的两个缓存行会互相驱逐（冲突缺失）。

本任务的数据缓存：256 字节，直接映射，16 个 16 字节的缓存行（每行 4 个字）。地址位划分为：位 1–0 是字节偏移，位 3–2 是行内的字，位 7–4 是组号，其余是标记（tag）。

矩阵按行存储：m[r][c] 位于 matrix + (16r + c) · 4。沿着一列向下访问时每一步跳过 64 字节，所以每次访问都落在不同的缓存行中，而一列的 16 行只用到 16 个组中的 4 个。

保真度。命中和缺失次数来自轨迹中记录的数据访问，按照与 Ripes 缓存模拟器相同的缓存规则计算；你可以在缓存选项卡中观察同一个缓存（数据缓存：2N 路数 = 0，2N 组数 = 4，2N 每行字数 = 2，LRU，写回，写分配）。Ripes 的处理器使用理想存储器，所以在 Ripes 中一次缺失不花费任何周期。在时序模型上则不然：在 gem5 的乱序 CPU 上做的同类实验（4 KiB L1 数据缓存，2048 次加载，见 tools/gem5/README.md）中，跨步访问用了 6,939 个周期、发生 2,030 次 L1 缺失，顺序访问用了 2,601 个周期、发生 119 次缺失。

steps.title: 加载程序
steps.instruction: 点击加载示例和选择处理器。该程序按列对一个 16 × 16 的矩阵求和。

steps.title: 运行并检查和
steps.instruction: 运行到结束。1 … 256 的和是 a0 = 32896。在探索器中查看 lw 指令：从一行到下一行，它们的地址增加 64 字节。

steps.title: 测量数据缓存
steps.instruction: 256 次加载每次都缺失：一列会访问 16 个不同的缓存行，它们争用 4 个组；等到下一列再次需要某个缓存行时，它已经被驱逐了。与按上述方式配置的缓存选项卡进行比较。

challenge.text: 用全部 256 次加载计算同样的和（a0 = 32896），并在本任务的缓存上达到至少 70 % 的数据缓存命中率。
challenge.hint: 按照矩阵在内存中的存储顺序访问它：交换两层循环，使相邻的加载相隔 4 个字节。

zh_CN.completion: 按行访问时，每次缺失都会取回一个包含四个字的缓存行，接下来的三次加载都命中：64 次缺失，192 次命中（75 %）。按列访问时，每次加载都缺失。同样的指令、同样的结果，内存行为却截然不同；在拥有真实存储系统的处理器上，这种差别就会变成时间。
